body:
Needed for https://github.com/CliMA/Oceananigans.jl/pull/5799, but also makes `compute_cell_areas` 6x faster for everyone.  Suggested by @vchuravy.

> `spherical_area_triangle` collected its vertices into `Vector`s and used `LinearAlgebra.dot` and `cross` on them, i.e. BLAS, and `spherical_quadrilateral_vertices` built its vertices as `Vector`s too. Every area allocated, and the functions couldn't be used in GPU kernels (Oceananigans computes the areas of tripolar grid cells in a kernel, which with KernelAbstractions 0.10 is compiled even on the CPU, and the BLAS call made LLVM abort).
> 
> Convert the vertices to `SVector`s instead of collecting them, which accepts the same inputs (tuples, vectors) without allocating, and build the vertices of `spherical_quadrilateral_vertices` as `SVector`s. The areas don't allocate any more, and `compute_cell_areas` on a 40×40 grid takes 144 μs and allocates 12.9 KB (its result) instead of 892 μs and 5.6 MB, with areas equal to the previous ones within 3e-15 relative.
title: Compute spherical areas with StaticArrays instead of heap vectors
